claims.claim: This is a motor speed reducer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a silver metal alternator with cooling fins, a round mounting flange with bolt holes, and a central shaft opening, not a motor speed reducer.

risks.risk: The alternator has not been tested and may not function
risks.proof: Video of a bench test showing the unit spinning and producing electrical output

risks.risk: Age, mileage, or hours of previous use are unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the nameplate or service records showing age and use history

risks.risk: Vehicle make, model, or year it fits is unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the part number or a fitment chart matched to a specific vehicle

risks.risk: Internal bearings, brushes, or windings may be worn or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up video of the internal components or a bearing spin test

risks.risk: Pulley, fan, or electrical plug may not be included
risks.proof: Photo showing all accessories attached to the unit
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a bare unit without accessories

risks.risk: Seller location in Lagos and pickup details are unknown
risks.proof: Geotagged photo or confirmed address and pickup arrangement

proof_requests: Video of the alternator being bench-tested for output
Photo of the part number or nameplate
Photo showing whether the pulley, fan, and electrical plug are included
Close-up of the shaft and mounting flange to confirm fitment
response.reason: The witness identified the item as an alternator, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's claim that it is a motor speed reducer is contradicted by the photos.
